answer: Sequential proof-of-work prices each identity in unforgeable time. Joining needs one non-parallelizable puzzle tied to the public key: one hour of single-thread compute, immune to extra hardware. Forging N identities burns N serial hours, so 1,000 puppets cost 1,000 hours, scaling linearly, while an honest agent pays once. Like a garden, identities grow one by one. No ocean of fakes spawns at once; echoing the trick a thousand times multiplies the bill.
